name: Fair Access for Individuals to Receive Leave Act

timeline.text: Message on Senate action sent to the House.
timeline.label: Update

timeline.text: The House received a message from the Senate. The Senate passed S. 580, S. 1135, S. 1288, S. 2479, S. 3321, S. 4035, S. 4238, S. 4445, S. 4448, S. 4538, H.R. 973, H.R. 2478, H.R. 1520 amended, and H.R. 4624 amended.
timeline.label: Passage
timeline.explain: The real vote on the measure itself.

timeline.text: Senator Ernst spoke on her grandchildren and family leave. She then asked unanimous consent for the Senate to pass S.3321 – The Fair Leave Act. The Senate passed the bill by voice vote.
timeline.label: Consent request
timeline.explain: A senator asked to pass or schedule something without a vote; it goes through only if nobody objects.

timeline.text: Senator Ernst spoke on family leave. By voice vote, the Senate passed S.3321 – The Fair Leave Act, to amend the Family and Medical Leave Act of 1993, to repeal certain limits on leave for married individuals employed by the same employer.
timeline.label: Passage
timeline.explain: The real vote on the measure itself.

timeline.text: Passed Senate without amendment by Voice Vote.
timeline.label: Amendment
timeline.explain: A vote on a proposed change, not on the bill itself.

timeline.text: Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions discharged by Unanimous Consent.
timeline.label: Update

timeline.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
timeline.label: Introduced / sent to committee
